figures.shows: Upper panel shows the 1.3 mm high-resolution continuum map of the W51 IRS2 region as colour image with white contours and 3 mm continuum as red contours; lower panel shows the 3 mm to 1.3 mm spectral index map with 1.3 mm contours overlaid.

axes.quantity: 1.3 mm and 3 mm continuum in sigma levels
axes.units: sigma (1.3 mm sigma=0.15 mJy beam-1; 3 mm sigma=0.08 mJy beam-1)

readable_values: approx. colour bar peak 0.0175 Jy beam-1 at W51 North
approx. spectral index colour range -2 to 5
approx. W51 North brightest knot near RA 19h23m40.05s, Dec 14d31m05.5s
figures.caption_quote: Color image represents the spectral index map that was derived from the 1.3 and 3 mm high-resolution continuum maps.

figures.shows: Full-region 1.3 mm continuum image with uv range above 910 kλ, plus zoomed panels of seven subclumps (CA to CG) with fragment crosses and labels, and a top zoom of CB.
readable_values: approx. colour bar maximum 0.0175 Jy beam-1 in full region
approx. CF1 peak 0.022 Jy beam-1
approx. CB zoom peak 0.006 Jy beam-1
approx. CA zoom peak 0.010 Jy beam-1
figures.caption_quote: We identiﬁed fragments as sources with at least one closed contour above the 12σ (1.32 mJy beam−1) identiﬁcation threshold. A total of 33 continuum objects have been identiﬁed in the region.

figures.shows: Upper panel histogram of angular separations of companions; lower panel mean surface density of companions (MSDC) versus angular separation with a random-distribution reference and a linear fit below the first break.

axes.units: deg (top axis in AU, D=5128 pc)

axes.quantity: log mean surface density of companions MSDC

figures.validation_check: Compares the observed MSDC against 1000 uniformly random realisations of the 29 fragments to show where clustering departs from random distribution.
readable_values: approx. histogram peak 52 companions near log theta 3.6
approx. first MSDC break at log theta about -4.3 deg (about 3000 AU)
approx. lower-panel small-separation log MSDC about 8.9 deg-2
approx. fitted slope -0.8
figures.caption_quote: The linear ﬁtting toward the data points at separations smaller than the ﬁrst break, marked as a red dashed line in the bottom panel, results in a slope of –0.8(±0.1).

figures.shows: 1.3 mm low-resolution continuum map (uv 9-910 kλ) in colour with high-resolution contours, overlaid with small-scale ensembles (SE1 to SE5) as small circles and large-scale ensembles (LE1, LE2) as large circles.
readable_values: approx. colour bar maximum 0.5 Jy beam-1 at SE1
approx. scale bar 5000 AU
approx. LE1 diameter about 15000 AU
figures.caption_quote: Overall, ﬁve SEs and two LEs are deﬁned in the region, and their names are labeled in the ﬁgure.

figures.shows: Anticorrelation between clustering-to-binary scale from the MSDC plot and stellar density, comparing W51 IRS2 with OMC-1S, Taurus, Ophiucus and Trapezium.
figures.validation_check: Compares the W51 IRS2 clustering-to-binary scale with literature clouds to test the stellar-density anticorrelation.
readable_values: approx. Taurus scale 12000 AU at about 1.4 stars pc-3
approx. Ophiucus scale 5000 AU at about 140 stars pc-3
approx. Trapezium scale 400 AU at about 24000 stars pc-3
approx. W51IRS2 scale 180 AU at about 25000 stars pc-3
figures.caption_quote: Anticorrelation between the clustering-to-binary scale in the MSDC plot and stellar density for diﬀerent clouds.
